title: Performance Testing knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Performance Testing”?
options: Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.

Performance Testing is a performance decision, not a rule to apply blindly. Start from a representative query and data distribution, inspect explain() evidence, and compare read improvements with write, memory and storage overhead.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
